findings.detail: B02 is treating a legitimate investment row and a separate unfunded-commitment row with the same issuer/instrument terms as duplicate position keys.

rationale: The named duplicate example localizes to two different source schedules: table 55 is the schedule of investments with Aptean's funded revolving-loan position at fair value 971, while table 66 is the unfunded commitments schedule with the same issuer/instrument and separate commitment fields. The filing total fair value is 6,207,136 thousand, matching the extracted fund-quarter fair value of 6,207.165 million within rounding/noise, so the duplicate-key check appears over-scoped rather than proving duplicated holdings.
